div.p: The fragments from the Oxford drawings have been digitally edited by Sara Fenoglio and Elena Barchielli as part of the course on Digital Editions of Fragmentary Texts at Ca'Foscari University of Venice. The fragments from PHerc. 817 have been digitally edited by Adrian Bippes, Emil Stopper, Lea Tappenbeck, Marianna Vinciguerra and Yulun Wu during a course on Latin papyrology taught at Universität Heidelberg. Revision by Holger Essler.
